title: The Siberian War
summary: A Wendigo memory of war with the Get of Fenris.

claims.text: Wendigo tales say that at the height of the Impergium some Get of Fenris began killing Wendigo Kinfolk in Siberia, and the Wendigo answered in kind.
The fighting spread across the tundra as open war, and some Russian ghost stories are said to be garbled memories of it.
Neither tribe recalls how it ended; most guess it faded along with the Impergium itself.

title: Wendigo in the South
summary: Old Wendigo ties to the Fera and to South America.

claims.text: Wendigo say they mostly ignored the Fera of the north and sometimes hunted Wyrm beasts beside them, fighting them only over prey or places of power.
South America was the exception, where some hold that the War of Rage never truly ended; the Uktena fought most there, sometimes glad of Wendigo help and sometimes calling them intruders.

title: The Fall of the Storm Eater
summary: The great rite of 1889 as the Wendigo tell it.

claims.text: The Storm Eater, a blend of Weaver and Wyrm, was destroyed in 1889 by a rite the Pure Ones and Wyrmcomers found together; the Wendigo say its exact form is now lost.
One great hero of each of the thirteen tribes gave up life willingly to power the weapon, and the Wendigo hero was Spear of Winter of the north.
The rite ran from one full moon to the next and killed many of the Theurges who led it; cleansing the Umbra afterward took far longer.
Rumour holds the Dust Bowl was the beast's dying breath and that storms of Tornado Alley are its offspring.
Wendigo say a strange energy lingers at Wounded Knee Creek, perhaps a pit reaching toward the Abyss.
Some believe another great Wyrm beast, as dreadful as Eater of Souls, will one day rise from beneath it, and advise keeping well clear.
